Population increased in Lewes

The estimated population of Lewes in 2024 was 102,363 usual residents, a rise of 0.7% since 2023.

This meant that Lewes' rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Lewes increased by 2.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Lewes was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Lewes

The average (median) age stayed at 48.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Lewes has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Lewes is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Lewes' population of 102,363 usual residents was made up of:

  • 16,606 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.2%)
  • 58,096 people aged 16 to 64 years, (56.8%)
  • 27,661 people aged 65 years and over, (27%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Lewes has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (27% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Lewes, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Lewes
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Lewes, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 511 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 747 births and 1,258 deaths in Lewes.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,007 (1%). There were 6,679 people entering the area and 5,672 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Lewes' population of 312 (0.3%) as a result of 581 people entering the area and 269 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Lewes was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Lewes in mid-2023 is 101,605.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 181 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 68 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 249 people.
